engine: PostgreSQL 17.11 (Homebrew), disposable local cluster, destroyed after use

T1_firstEverClientNoToken.significance: Guards the RECORD-vs-%ROWTYPE trap the v2 reviewer demonstrated. A RECORD declaration raises 'record g is not assigned yet' on every first-time client.

T2_starvationFix.observed: after 5 mint-and-abandon resets on one bucket (units=5 grants=5), a BRAND-NEW client is ADMITTED
T2_starvationFix.significance: The v2 network-lockout defect is fixed by REMOVING the redundant grant-slot cap, not by mitigating it.

T3_resetContinuityBounded.observed: at 48/50 a fresh grant opens with 2 units; at 50/50 the next new client gets REFUSED_BUCKET_EXHAUSTED

T4_twoClientIndependence.observed: A exhausted -> REFUSED_GRANT; B on the same bucket -> ADMITTED

T5_crossBucketGrantReplay.observed: grant minted on bucket 05 presented against bucket 06 is not matched; a fresh grant is issued for 06

T6_windowBoundary.observed: grant from window 1 ignored in window 2; window 2 bucket starts at 0

T8_concurrency.method: 40 parallel callers, all new clients, BUCKET_ALLOWANCE=10
